title: Embedded CSS boundary
caption: The current boundary records raw style payloads as opaque spans, keeps them out of the JavaScript AST, and restores their original bytes after formatting.

nodes.source: A lowercase style element in authored TSRX contains a raw CSS payload.
nodes.scan: The TSRX scanner recognizes the style boundary but does not parse, validate, lint, or format its CSS.
nodes.opaque: The raw payload is stored as an opaque span that borrows its bytes from the original source.
nodes.projection: The JavaScript projection replaces the payload with a synthetic marker, so raw CSS stays outside the OXC JavaScript AST.
nodes.lift: The formatter lift uses the recorded span and marker to restore the embedded payload in source order.
nodes.output: The output contains the original raw CSS bytes unchanged. CSS diagnostics and CSS formatting remain outside this boundary.
